source_of_truth: Reading the three files: (A) app/lib/http.ts creates one module-level Axios instance whose Authorization default is mutated globally - a cross-request token leak under SSR. (B) app/stores/account.ts fetches invoices via http.get/post and keeps them as a ref<Invoice[]> entity array (server data duplicated outside the query cache) while also holding an accessToken, and the whole store is persist:true (tokens + server data persisted to storage). (D) its logout clears only the in-memory token, not query caches or app state. Four distinct real defects derived from the code, independent of the tool.

expected.rationale: Module-level axios.create whose defaults.headers.common.Authorization is mutated: one user's token can serve another's SSR request.
Store fetches (http.get/post) and keeps an entity array (ref<Invoice[]>): server data belongs in a query cache, not duplicated in a store.
persist:true on a whole store that holds accessToken: never persist tokens or server data wholesale.
logout resets only accessToken; it clears no store/query cache/persisted state, so stale user data and the persisted token survive logout.
